12104-ethelyn-s-mistake.title: Mistake
12104-ethelyn-s-mistake.creator: Mary J. Holmes
12104-ethelyn-s-mistake.description: A book by Mary J. Holmes. There was a sweet odor of clover blossoms in the early morning air, and the dew stood in great drops upon the summer flowers, and dropped from the foliage of the elm trees which skirted the village common. There was a cloud of mist upon the meadows, and the windings of the river could be distinctly traced by the white fog which curled above it.

arxiv-1406-2167.title: The axial form factor and polarization of
arxiv-1406-2167.creator: the final nucleon in quasi-elastic
arxiv-1406-2167.description: Abstract We have calculated the polarization of the final nucleon in charged current quasi-elastic ν − N \nu-N scattering. We show that the longitudinal and transverse polarizations, as well as their ratio exhibit simple dependence on the axial form factor and their sensitivity to the axial mass is much stronger than that of the cross section.

arxiv-2202-02177.title: Generalised Score Distribution: A Two-Parameter Discrete Distribution Accurately Describing Responses from Quality of Experience Subjective Experiments
arxiv-2202-02177.creator: Jakub Nawała, Lucjan Janowski, Bogdan Ćmiel, Krzysztof Rusek, Pablo Pérez
arxiv-2202-02177.description: Abstract Subjective responses from Multimedia Quality Assessment (MQA) experiments are conventionally analysed with methods not suitable for the data type these responses represent. Furthermore, obtaining subjective responses is resource intensive. A method allowing reuse of existing responses would be thus beneficial. Applying improper data analysis methods leads to difficult to interpret results. This encourages drawing erroneous conclusions.

arxiv-2212-10696.title: Analyzing Semantic Faithfulness of Language Models via Input Intervention on Question Answering
arxiv-2212-10696.creator: Akshay Chaturvedi, Swarnadeep Bhar, Soumadeep Saha, Utpal Garain, Nicholas Asher
arxiv-2212-10696.description: Abstract Transformer-based language models have been shown to be highly effective for several NLP tasks. In this paper, we consider three transformer models, BERT, RoBERTa, and XLNet, in both small and large versions, and investigate how faithful their representations are with respect to the semantic content of texts.

arxiv-2304-05449.title: Nonclassicality generated by propagation of atoms through a cavity field
arxiv-2304-05449.creator: Arpita Chatterjee
arxiv-2304-05449.description: Abstract We successively pass two V V -type three-level atoms through a single-mode cavity field. Considering the field to be initially in a classical state, we evaluate various statistical properties such as the quasiprobability Q Q function, Wigner distribution, Mandel’s Q Q parameter and normal squeezing of the resulted field.

arxiv-2310-01451.title: Localization of scalar field on the brane-world by coupling with gravity
arxiv-2310-01451.creator: Heng Guo, Yong-Tao Lu, Cai-Ling Wang, and Yue Sun
arxiv-2310-01451.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Heng Guo, Yong-Tao Lu, Cai-Ling Wang, and Yue Sun. In this paper, we consider a coupling mechanism between the kinetic term and the gravity, in which a coupling function F ⁡ ( R ) F(R) is introduced into the kinetic term of the five-dimensional scalar field. Based on this scenario, we investigate the localization of scalar fields in three specific braneworld models: the Minkowski brane, the de Sitter brane, and the Anti-de Sitter brane.

arxiv-2406-07604.title: Soft zero for cylindrical gravitational waves
arxiv-2406-07604.creator: Robert Penna
arxiv-2406-07604.description: Abstract The graviton 𝒮 \mathcal{S} -matrix has a famous soft pole. We show that the 𝒮 \mathcal{S} -matrix for cylindrical gravitational waves has a soft zero. The soft pole for ordinary gravitons comes from a Ward identity for supertranslation symmetry at asymptotic infinity.

arxiv-2412-02950.description: Abstract Autonomous Mobile Robots operating in indoor industrial environments require a localization system that is reliable and robust. arxiv-2502-08873.title: Robust Graph-Based Semi-Supervised Learning via p p -Conductances
arxiv-2502-08873.creator: Sawyer Jack Robertson, Chester Holtz, Zhengchao Wan, Gal Mishne ‡, Alexander Cloninger
arxiv-2502-08873.description: Abstract We study the problem of semi-supervised learning on graphs in the regime where data labels are scarce or possibly corrupted. We propose an approach called p p -conductance learning that generalizes the p p -Laplace and Poisson learning methods by introducing an objective reminiscent of p p -Laplacian regularization and an affine relaxation of the label constraints.

arxiv-2506-09975.title: When Detection Fails: The Power of Fine-Tuned Models to Generate Human-Like Social Media Text
arxiv-2506-09975.creator: Hillary Dawkins, Kathleen C. Fraser, Svetlana Kiritchenko
arxiv-2506-09975.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hillary Dawkins, Kathleen C. Fraser, Svetlana Kiritchenko. Detecting AI-generated text is a difficult problem to begin with; detecting AI-generated text on social media is made even more difficult due to the short text length and informal, idiosyncratic language of the internet. It is nonetheless important to tackle this problem, as social media represents a significant attack vector in online influence campaigns, which may be bolstered through the use of mass-produced AI-generated posts supporting (or opposing) particular policies, decisions, or events.

arxiv-2602-03761.creator: Sankha Subhra Bakshi, Yunhao Fan, Gia-Wei Chern
arxiv-2602-03761.description: Abstract We investigate the nonequilibrium dynamics of a laser-pumped two-dimensional spinless Holstein model within a semiclassical framework, focusing on the melting and recovery of long-range charge-density-wave order. Accurately describing this process requires fully nonadiabatic electron–lattice dynamics, which is computationally demanding due to the need to resolve fast electronic motion over long time scales.

In this study, vegan basil pesto was designed and enriched with 1% and 2% Arthrospira platensis (spirulina).
